Settlement Demand
October 24, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1251 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client, Jennifer Watts, regarding the mtoor vehicle collision that occurred on March 31,
2024. On that date, our client was traveling and began a left turn when the vehicle insured under your policy struck
the driver's side of our client's car. The facts of the collision are straightforward, and the police report and
photographs taken at the scene support our client's account that your insured failed to yield the right of way.
As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a serious shoulder injury. Medical records document the diagnosis,
the course of treatment, and ongoing limitations on our client's ability to lift, reach, and perform everyday tasks. Our
client has incurred medical expenses, lost wages from time away from work, and continues to experience pain and
reduced mobility.
Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore request that your company
resolve this claim by tendering payment in the amount of $205,000.00. This offer will remain open for thirty days from
the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further
notice and seek all damages available under the law.
Please direct all future correspondence regarding this matter to my office.
Expert review: Katherine Moore, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
